mentions.name: MiserablyUnemployed
mentions.description: A free job site with resume tools that aggregates 2.7M+ job listings and automatically removes any posting older than 7 days while disallowing reposts, so users only see fresh openings.
mentions.problem: The job market is a nightmare: any job posted for 7+ days almost certainly has 1000+ applicants already, so applying to stale postings is just 'feeding your resume into a wood chipper'.
mentions.audience: Job seekers from all over the world
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building MiserablyUnemployed for the better part of this year. https://miserablyunemployed.com/

It's a free job site with some resume tools bolted on. Lots of people from all over the world are using it and that feels great.

It has 2.7M+ jobs and automatically removes any job older than 7 days. We never allow reposts because, frankly, the job market is a nightmare and any job that has been up for 7+ days almost certainly has 1000+ applicants already.

mentions.name: MiserablyUnemployed.com
mentions.description: A job search platform that aggregates fresh job listings from tens of thousands of company HR pages, keeping postings for only seven days (unless filled) and excluding reposts. It includes a resume builder, a job matching system, an application-assistance browser extension, job tracking software, and an interview preparation helper.
mentions.problem: Job boards are cluttered with stale and reposted listings; the site keeps jobs for only seven days and excludes reposts so users see only fresh openings.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been slowly building [MiserablyUnemployed.com](https://miserablyunemployed.com/) for the last four or five months.

It pulls jobs from tens of thousands of company HR pages, and only keeps them for seven days (unless it sees that the job has been filled). No reposts. Only fresh jobs.
